title: Referrals and Authorizations Release of Inpatient Days on a Confirmed Closure
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirms the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime whose stay has ended, it is closed as cancelled that day and the inpatient days left on it are released.

## Release

The days left are the units granted plus the units added by extensions, less the units used, all read from the authorization's unit history. The release is every day left, and is never fewer than zero.

## Reading the unit history

| Entry | What it gives |
|---|---|
| Grant entries | the days granted on approval |
| Extension entries | the days added by each extension |
| Use entries | the days used, each with the service date the use counts from |

## Worked example (hypothetical unit history of an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization)

| Entry | Days |
|---|---|
| Grant | 7 |
| Extension 1 | 3 |
| Extension 2 | 3 |
| Use entries, in total | 9 |

Days left: 7 plus 3 plus 3, less 9, gives 4 days; the release is 4 days.

## Second example (hypothetical)

A Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization with 14 days granted, no extension and 14 days used has 0 days left; the release is 0.
